'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****Russian forces [[shell (projectile)|shell]] a [[psychiatric hospital]] in Strelechya, [[Kharkiv Oblast]], killing four medics and injuring two patients. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/sep/18/ukrainians-flee-shelling-of-kupiansk-as-russian-forces-try-to-slow-advances (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2022 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes]]
**The death toll from the fighting between [[Kyrgyzstan]] and [[Tajikistan]], which began four days ago, increases to 94. Fifty-nine of the people were killed in Kyrgyzstan, and the 35 others were killed in Tajikistan. Another 139 people are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62950787 (BBC News)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Ukraine]] withdraws its 250 [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|troops]] from the [[United Nations peacekeeping]] force [[MONUSCO]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. A [[Ukrainian Air Force]] aviation unit also withdraws its eight helicopters from the mission, which made up a third of the UN's fleet. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-62945971 (BBC News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Five gunmen storm a [[rehab center]] in the early morning in [[Cortazar, Guanajuato]], [[Mexico]], and [[mass shooting|open fire]], killing three people and injuring two others. [https://www.meganoticias.mx/cdmx/noticia/tres-muertos-dos-heridos-en-ataque-a-anexo-de-cortazar/360750 (MegaNoticias)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Taitung earthquakes]]
**A second [[list of earthquakes in Taiwan|earthquake]] in less than 24 hours strikes southeast [[Taiwan]], killing one person and wounding 146 other people. The 6.9 magnitude [[earthquake]] is felt in [[Taipei]] and [[tsunami warning]]s are issued. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/powerful-earthquake-hits-southeast-taiwan-2022-09-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Guizhou bus crash]]
**Twenty-seven people are killed and 20 others are injured when a bus carrying people to a [[COVID-19]] quarantine facility crashes on a highway in [[Sandu Shui Autonomous County|Sandu County]], [[Guizhou Province]], [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/bus-crash-kills-27-mountainous-southwest-china-2022-09-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Fiona]] makes landfall in [[Puerto Rico]] causing the entire island to lose [[electrical grid|power]]. The U.S. [[National Hurricane Center]] warns of "life-threatening flash flooding" on the island amid "historic" rainfall. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-storms-hurricanes-puerto-rico-tropical-01028dac6655ddb5b321f345cf9e9358 (AP)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change/news/hurricane-fiona-live-updates-puerto-rico-power-outage-b2169964.html (''The Independent'')]
